description:
The Firmstrong Bella 3-Speed is a fashionable cruiser bike designed for the rider who wants a great functional bicycle while making a stylish statement. This model comes fully equipped with all the premium details, including a Shimano 3-speed internal gear system, painted wheels, front and rear fenders, and beautiful Hawaiian flower decals. The sleek frame design and coordinated accessories give the Bella a high-end look, while the added gears provide significantly more capability than a traditional single-speed cruiser.

The three-speed internal gear system is one of the easiest and most reliable setups to operate. Because all the shifting takes place inside the rear hub, the chain does not need to move between sprockets to change gears. This results in a low-maintenance ride with far fewer mechanical headaches over time. The gears shift smoothly and seamlessly, even allowing you to change speeds without interrupting your pedal stroke. While there are only three gears, each one is precision-tuned for recreational needs. Gear one offers low resistance for tackling hills with ease, gear two is perfect for cruising at a steady pace of five to fifteen miles per hour, and gear three provides the highest resistance for hitting top speeds on flat straightaways or downhill glides.

To maintain its clean and classic aesthetic, the gear system uses only one cable, keeping the design uncluttered and simple. The ride itself is soft and effortless, thanks to the wide cruiser tires and dual-spring saddle that work together to absorb the shock from bumps in the road. For braking, we have kept it intuitive with a traditional coaster brake, where you simply pedal backwards to stop just like the original beach cruisers you remember. Built with a durable steel frame and an ergonomic upright riding position, the Bella 3-Speed is the perfect upgrade for the rider who wants a bit more versatility without sacrificing the timeless, feminine style of a beach cruiser.

15” Extended Length Steel Frame with 26” Painted Aluminum Wheels and Front/Rear Fenders

3 Speed Ladies Bike with Shimano Internal Gear System, shifts quickly and easily and requires little maintenance

Great recreational riding bike for taller women or those who would like more arm extension. 2” extended frame creates more space between rider and handlebars.

Thick top tube design with Hawaiian flowers, Front/Rear Fenders, and Painted Rims

Three Speed Bike with a Pedal-Backwards Coaster Brake for easy pedaling and smooth braking

Dual Spring Oversized Seat for Added Comfort

2.125” Wide White-Wall Tires provide a cushioned, relaxed ride for easy rolling

28.5” Wide Chrome Plated Cruiser Bike Handlebars with Synthetic Leather Black Grips

Bicycle Weighs 38 lbs. Fully Assembled

Fits Most Women 5’ – 6’ Tall

Recommended Riding Speed 3 – 25mph

Recommended Riding Distance 0 – 35 miles in a single trip

The Seat and Handlebar Height and Tilt can be adjusted to properly fit the rider

Bike comes 85% Assembled, Assembly is easy and fun!

Designed in Hermosa Beach, CA.
